note: Trace form (research/trace-harness.md) for L13's compose form: the static twins' service, served by scripts/trace.sh against PostgreSQL. REPORTING_URL is the same database as DATABASE_URL. The connections probe lists the app role's backends at the database (pg_stat_activity) before and after each request: a request that opens a connection on every run after the warm-up makes its pool per request (L13-c2). L13-c1, pools across processes and replicas over max_connections, is a sum over the deployment's configuration, which one served process cannot show; it is confirmed by the static check and by the load run. defects are what the planted twin must report and the clean twin must not; every other request is a decoy, in both twins. symbol names the handler each request runs: the static finding for a pool made per request has no endpoint, so it is linked by symbol.
